liveStory.label: Live story
liveStory.preparing: {callSign} is getting ready: leaving in {seconds} s
liveStory.enRoute: {callSign} {meters, number} m away, arriving in {seconds} s
liveStory.arrived: {callSign} on scene: {category, select, FIRE {the crew attacks the fire} TECHNICAL {the crew makes the area safe} ROAD {the crew helps the people involved} MEDICAL {the crew assesses the patient} WATER {the crew reaches the people in the water} POLICE {the patrol takes charge} other {the crew gets to work}}
liveStory.working: {category, select, FIRE {Fire under control} TECHNICAL {Work in progress} ROAD {Rescue in progress} MEDICAL {Care in progress} WATER {Recovery in progress} other {Intervention in progress}}, {pct}%
liveStory.almostDone: {category, select, FIRE {Fire almost out} TECHNICAL {Almost done} ROAD {Road almost clear} MEDICAL {Patient almost ready} WATER {Recovery almost done} other {Almost done}}, {pct}%
liveStory.resolving: On-scene work finished: closing the intervention
liveStory.transporting: {callSign} is taking the patient to hospital

outcome.label: Mission outcome
outcome.title: Mission {mission} complete!
outcome.finishedBody: From now on calls come in on their own: keep an eye on the queue.

praise.RESPOND: You answered at once: the vehicles left within seconds.
praise.CHOOSE_VEHICLE: You picked the right vehicle for the job yourself.
praise.MULTI_VEHICLE: Two vehicles together: the fire stood no chance.
praise.REDIRECT: You sent the vehicle straight there, without going back to the station.
praise.FREE: All on your own, without a single mistake.
praise.FAST: Fast response: the vehicles arrived in time.

bubble.openCall: New call: open it to see what is happening
bubble.sendRecommended: One tap here and the recommended vehicles leave
bubble.watchStory: Follow the story here: departure, arrival, work
bubble.tickVehicle: This time you choose: tick the right vehicle
bubble.sendChosen: Now send the vehicle you picked
bubble.redirectHere: The vehicle is on its way back: send it here without stopping at the station
bubble.needSecond: Two vehicles are needed: buy the second with the credits you won
bubble.buySecond: Buy the second fire engine here
bubble.delivering: The new fire engine reaches the station in a few seconds
bubble.backToCall: Done! Go back to the call and send both vehicles

skip.title: Do you really want to play without the guide?
skip.body: The first missions stay short: only the guide goes away.

patientGuide.SEND: Assessment: send an ambulance. On arrival the crew examines the patient and gives them a colour code.
patientGuide.ASSESS: Assessment: on arrival the crew examines the patient and gives them a colour code.
patientGuide.TREAT: Care: on scene the crew stabilises the patient. The more serious, the longer it takes.
patientGuide.HOSPITAL: Hospital: choose where to take them below and the ambulance leaves.
patientGuide.DONE: Done: the patient is in good hands. From now on you know how to do it.
